title: How Far Can You Steer? Behavior-Capability Frontiers in Contrastive Activation Addition
abstract: arXiv:2611.06001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering can modify language-model behavior without parameter updates, but behavioral efficacy alone does not determine whether an intervention is usable. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) steers targeted behaviors using activation directions derived from contrasting examples, potentially degrading unrelated model capabilities in the process. We therefore study CAA through a behavior-capability frontier, selecting interventions that maximize behavioral gain subject to an explicit bound on capability degradation. We evaluate this framework across four instruction-tuned models, seven behaviors, and capability-loss budgets of 1%, 3%, and 5% (absolute percentage points). Validation-selected behavioral effects generalize strongly to held-out data ($\rho = 0.945$), while joint behavior-capability survival among nonzero operating points rises from 37.5% at the 1% budget to 72.7% at 3%, with limited additional improvement at 5%.

translated_title: 你能引导多远？对比激活添加中的行为-能力前沿
translated_abstract: 激活引导可以在不更新参数的情况下修改语言模型的行为，但仅凭行为效果并不能决定一项干预措施是否可用。对比激活添加（CAA）利用从对比样本中提取的激活方向来引导目标行为，但在此过程中可能会损害模型的其他无关能力。因此，我们通过行为-能力前沿来研究CAA，在明确的能力退化界限约束下，选择能够最大化行为收益的干预措施。我们在四个指令微调模型、七种行为以及1%、3%和5%（绝对百分点）的能力损失预算下对该框架进行了评估。结果显示，基于验证集筛选出的行为效果能够很好地泛化到留出数据上（ρ = 0.945）；而在非零工作点中，行为与能力同时达标的联合存活率从1%预算下的37.5%上升到3%预算下的72.7%，在5%预算下的额外改进则较为有限。
tldr: 该论文提出“行为-能力前沿”框架来评估对比激活添加（CAA）的可用性，在能力退化明确预算约束下最大化行为收益，发现行为效果具有强泛化性（ρ=0.945），且将能力损失预算从1%提高到3%可使干预的联合存活率从37.5%显著提升至72.7%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a behavior-capability frontier framework for evaluating Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), selecting interventions that maximize behavioral gain under explicit capability-degradation budgets, showing that behavioral effects generalize strongly (ρ=0.945) and that joint behavior-capability survival rises from 37.5% at a 1% capability-loss budget to 72.7% at 3%.
